source_assessments.reason: The SDK warning changes whether a copied client example actually requests an eligible authorization. Correct retained omission and sample scope while preserving unchanged network rules and Charge-based lifecycle.

answers.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/features/extended-authorizations, May 1 and November 7 describe an eligible merchant's Terminal integration requesting card-present extended authorization at PaymentIntent creation using payment_method_options.card_present.request_extended_authorization=true and capture_method=manual. Confirmation establishes an authorization that can be captured later, with eligibility and length dependent on brand and merchant category. Visa, Mastercard, American Express and Discover are listed; Interac and eftpos are excluded as single-message methods. Connect users set connected-account MCCs to match their businesses. The merchant reads capture_before from the confirmed payment's Charge to learn its actual deadline. If capture misses the deadline the authorization expires, funds release, and PaymentIntent becomes canceled (old raw lines 8-18, old raw lines 112-128; new raw lines 9-21, new raw lines 108-124). November explicitly requires manual capture for client creation with iOS/Android SDK 6.0.0 because the default is automatic-asynchronous, and shows a React Native example setting manual (old raw lines 93-102; new raw line 21, new raw lines 88-98). source-stripe-terminal-extended-authorizations captures the earlier flow and network table but omits SDK caveats, exact field placement and the expiry release detail.
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/features/extended-authorizations, update source-stripe-terminal-extended-authorizations and retain the May 1 functional evidence, the reciprocal stripe-terminal-extended-authorizations concept, its versioned iOS/Android evidence, and the related incremental authorization and PaymentIntent request routes. November 7's substantive caveat is explicit manual capture on iOS/Android SDK 6.0.0 because the default changed to automatic-asynchronous; the unchanged shown Swift and Kotlin builders omit manual and are incomplete for that version. The React Native sample adds manual with no release boundary specified here. The server create sample moves from payment_method_types to allowed_payment_method_types[]; date the example and keep any version compatibility attributed to its separate package evidence. Switching Node to cURL, TSX fencing and table/footnote formatting are presentational; migration links are navigation (old raw lines 16-50, old raw lines 64-79, old raw lines 93-102; new raw lines 17-45, new raw lines 59-74, new raw lines 88-98). Both captures preserve the typical 48 hours or Visa five days, exact Visa 29d18h/9d18h, Mastercard all categories excluding Maestro/Cirrus, Amex lodging/vehicle rental with capture by end of stay or rental and Discover specified categories. Use capture_before on the confirmed Charge and keep the missed-deadline release/canceled transition (old raw lines 8-14, old raw lines 112-128; new raw lines 9-15, new raw lines 108-124).
